## Refactor authorization into a capability registry

The legacy `base._PERMS` map is a wall of bare permission strings and is easy to get wrong when adding a role. This refactor introduces (1) named capability constants grouped by resource, (2) an explicit per-role capability registry built from those constants, and (3) an `Authorizer` facade for request handlers.

Behaviour is unchanged: every role keeps exactly the capabilities it had before. `owner` stays a wildcard superuser; all other roles are spelled out so an audit can read a role's powers directly. An import-time self-check rejects typo'd capability strings.

### Tests
Existing authorization tests pass unchanged (per-role allow/deny across org, member, billing, project, content, report, audit and secret actions).
